purpose: MDB source-capability and encoding research before Bella implementation
policyStatus: Research and recommendations, not newly approved MDB rules. Existing retained result fields and fresh Bella/OldScanner separation remain approved. No Bella runtime code changed.

mediaComposer.scope: Read-only static arm64 disassembly and manual control/data-flow reconstruction of installed Media Composer; no launch, private API execution, write to media, or Bella implementation.

dictionary.evidence: Native dictionary explicitly names OMF classes, properties and UTF8 counterparts; definitions are property-specific, not a single encoding for the whole MDB.

encoding.conclusion: The traced legacy component-name route uses current-Mac decoding. It does not inspect a UTF8 prefix or OMFI:CharacterSet. This proves that route, not that all historical MDB names are universally MacRoman. No named CPNT:NameUTF8 counterpart found in native dictionary.

encoding.conclusion: Prefer named Unicode bin-name property when available. This is recorded Original Bin metadata, unrelated to changing the Bin Filter.

functions.name: omfiDualStream::ReadUTF8StringAndConvertToUTF16
steps: Reads named bytes via UTF8 read slot0x2a0

encoding.conclusion: These are UTF8 by named schema/native reader; not PMR counted strings, no mandatory PMR two-byte prefix should be imposed on them.

Kind4 branch0x1764e8 reads BobSize, allocates that size and reads BobData bytes

encoding.conclusion: Project is not categorically legacy text: known typed UTF8 attribute representations also exist. Read only schema-established text attributes, retain hierarchy and type; do not decode arbitrary BobData as text.

functions.name: CoreAttrList::AddUTF8String

encoding.conclusion: Known Unicode attributes can store two-zero-byte marker plus UTF8 in Kind4 blob; Kind4 alone and zero prefix alone are not enough to interpret arbitrary binary properties. Actual Name under PreservedBinData is archived column data; not proved a direct ClipName replacement.

numericFields.conclusion: Rates, lengths, dimensions, compression identifiers and references are typed binary data, not UTF8 or MacRoman. Descriptor rate and physical descriptor length belong together; composition/track duration need not describe the full physical file.

limits: No new executable or private-reader run; this is static code evidence.
No universal producer encoding established for all legacy MDB text, especially Windows. Current-Mac byte decoding is proven only on traced routes.
OMFI:CharacterSet is present in native dictionaries but no use establishing an originating legacy codepage was observed on traced name/project routes; a complete global use audit was not performed.
No primary native evidence promotes PreservedBinData/Name to current master ClipName; keep hierarchy.
Legacy/modern OMF schema and Bento container revision are separate; six current genuine files are audited independently by parent/team.
A fresh Bella parser implementation must wait for remaining source requirements; this report makes proposals, not runtime changes.

mdvx.purpose: Read-only installed MDVx MDB scanner/enrichment audit for Bella requirements. No production or media files changed; no MDVx app scan or UI launched.
mdvx.method: Fresh nm/otool static instruction tracing, Objective-C metadata and manual control/data-flow reconstruction, plus independent actual MDB TOC/property inspection and a minimal Foundation converter program using the traced NSString API. This audit does not claim new Hopper decompiler output.

container.fileRead: openFile obtains complete NSData dataWithContentsOfURL and retains its bytes. Rejects files shorter than128bytes or with wrong final24byte Bento magic a4434da5486472d7.
container.formatImplemented: The actual parser implements a flat24byte Bento1 TOC. Header major==2 selects OMFiTOCReader02, which logs OMF2not supported and returns; no Bento2TOC decoding.
container.versionQualification: openFile explicitly rejects major2, but does not explicitly demand major1 before flat-TOC fallback. This is not evidence of genuine support for unknown Bento majors. Bento container version must not be equated with OMF schema revision.
container.byteOrder: Sets _isII by comparing label bytes+0xa with0x4949. Numeric property payloads generally use that flag to choose direct32bit values or reversed32bit values. FlatTOC fields themselves are accessed by direct native little-endian loads.
container.indexing: Builds objectID-to-firstTOC-index tree and separate CompositionMobs, MediaDataMobs and SourceMobs trees from head arrays. Index entries retain8byte UID excerpt plus Bento objectID.
container.propertyAccess: pDataFor returns bounded external payload pointer or immediate TOC value pointer; lookForProperty scans contiguous same-object entries and returns first matching property from supplied startindex. No duplicate-property ambiguity rejection was found in this routine.
container.safetyQualification: Do not copy these bounds checks as a safety specification: observed code assumes well-formed flatTOC/object grouping and has incomplete validation of the completeTOC extent and array payload counts.

ordinaryEnrichment.masterLookup: PMR material/master ID bytes16..23 → CompositionMobs tree → Bento object firstTOC index.
ordinaryEnrichment.fileLookup: PMR file ID bytes16..23 → SourceMobs tree → Bento object firstTOC index.

masterRetained.property: Generic GetStringForObjectAt scans object for first accepted string property; normally OMFI:CPNT:Name
CPNT:Attributes→ATTR:AttrRefs; if an attribute name begins _IMPORTSETTING, force usageCode15

fileRetained.property: _PJ string attribute directly or via referenced source mob
MOBJ:PhysicalMedia descriptor→DIDD:Compression; special _AUD marker for recognised audio path
PCMA:AudioSamplingRate; AIFD:Summary presence plus MDFL:SampleRate fallback; see numeric caveat
MDAU:BitsPerSample for recognised audio; CDCI:ComponentWidth on relevant video path

notReadByThisRoutine: Optional effect sequence/category graph beyond usageCode and import marker
ordinaryEnrichment.numericCaveat: For the non-audio descriptor branch, if DIDD:FrameSampleSize0x108ed and MDFL:SampleRate exist, getCompression_data reads FrameSampleSize into the returned sample-rate numerator slot and sets denominator1; addInfoToItem passes that slot to setSampleRateNumerator:denominator:, which stores bothwords. This is an observed stored intermediate, not a claim about final UI display or that FrameSampleSize is semantically an audio sampling rate.

text.scanEncoding: 0x100063b30..3b40 selects NSString encoding1 when _isII istrue, encoding30 otherwise, then trims NUL characters. SDK defines1=NSASCIIStringEncoding and30=NSMacOSRomanStringEncoding. No UTF8 property/kind dispatch occurs here.
text.projectPath: getProjectAttributeForObjectAt follows CPNT:Attributes→ATTR:AttrRefs, loops references in storedorder, compares first3 Namebytes to_PJ, calls GetStringForObjectAt starting at NameTOCindex+1. Thus next StringAttribute is accepted. Last matching_PJ reference replaces earlier string; no uniqueness check.
text.projectFallback: getProjectNameForObjAt first tries direct_PJ, else TRKG:Tracks→TRAK:TrackComponent→SEQU:Sequence→SCLP:SourceID, supporting32byte SourceID+16 excerpt or12byte SourceID+4 excerpt, then searches SourceMobs for source_PJ.
text.browserDifference: StringForTocIndexItem0x1000631bc, used for database browsing, separately recognises OMFI:FL:PathNameUTF8 property0x102e0 and uses encoding4=UTF8 at0x1000634a4..34dc. This is not the generic string routine called by ordinary scan enrichment.
text.converterConclusion: On this Mac the encoding1 NSString initializer permissively maps actual0xa7 to§; encoding30 maps it to the user-confirmedß. Thus the traced MDVx scanner converter can misdecode this actual legacy Project value. This conclusion combines static converter selection with measured Foundation conversion, not a live MDVx scan result.

bellaImplicationsNotApprovedRequirements: Use the actual named/type-aware property structure and correct text variant rules established from Media Composer; do not copy MDVx ASCII/byteorder heuristic as an encoding specification.
Retain complete identities and join correct file/master roles under already approved Bella policy rather than adopting MDVx8byte comparisons.
Select the metadata required by MediaMuster fields, including dimensions/physicalduration/OriginalBin/sourcepath where MDB actually supplies it, even if this MDVx enrichment routine omits it.
MDB remains metadata assistance; Bella physical inventory must remain independent of PMR/MDB membership.
limits: No MDVx runtime scan, final UI display comparison, timing or memory benchmark.
Ordinary scanner/enrichment path inspected; database browser/private unrelated workflows are only inspected where needed to distinguish text decoding.
No claim that MDVx cannot display UTF8 anywhere: its browser has a UTF8 path property branch and unrelated readers may support Unicode.
No malformed-input experiment against MDVx app; static safety observations are not an exhaustive vulnerability audit.
All genuine files inspected in this task are Bento1.0 with IIextra marker; no independently generated big-endian MDB corpus tested.
Bento major/version behavior does not settle every OMF schema-version feature.
